body.name: Moonbeam agent listings
body.description: Moonbeam lists agents on ERC-8004, the MCP Registry and A2A; listing runs on a plan (https://next.moonbeam.network/acp/plans). Each skill here answers one call, priced in USDC on Base mainnet and paid with x402, and states its price before you sign the payment.

skills.name: Market price
skills.description: One market.price answer, bought through Moonbeam and paid with x402 on Base. One call is 0.001714 USDC, paid with x402 on Base.

skills.name: Risk address
skills.description: One risk.address answer, bought through Moonbeam and paid with x402 on Base. One call is 0.0012 USDC, paid with x402 on Base.

skills.name: MCP digest
skills.description: One mcp.digest answer, bought through Moonbeam and paid with x402 on Base. One call is 0.0012 USDC, paid with x402 on Base.

skills.name: Gift cards search
skills.description: Search 10,000+ gift card & voucher brands across 180+ countries by name and country. Pay in USDC via x402, no account. 0.002 USDC a call.

skills.name: Products detail
skills.description: Get a product's packages, pricing, and recipient requirements before creating an invoice. 0.001 USDC a call.

skills.name: Invoice create
skills.description: Create a price-locked invoice for one or more gift cards, eSIMs, or mobile top-ups, payable in USDC or over Lightning. 0.002 USDC a call.

skills.name: Invoice status
skills.description: Check an invoice status and, with SIWX from the paying wallet or the Lightning payment preimage, retrieve redemption codes. 0.001 USDC a call.

skills.name: Checkout info
skills.description: Discover the Bitrefill x402 storefront: supported networks, the full route flow, and wallet persistence rules. 0.001 USDC a call.

skills.name: Q verdict resource
skills.description: Any agent can buy a Token Verdict over x402: AI grade, roast and live onchain metrics for any Base, Solana or Robinhood token. $0.02 in USDC, no account. 0.02 USDC a call.

skills.name: X402 buy
skills.description: Agentic checkout for Clash of Coins 0.02 USDC a call.

skills.name: X402 cheap health
skills.description: Low-cost gateway health probe for real x402 settlement checks 0.001 USDC a call.

skills.name: Chat completions
skills.description: AI chat completions API - pay per request with USDC on Base 0.002 USDC a call.

skills.name: Polymarket markets
skills.description: Query Polymarket markets with filtering, sorting, and pagination 0.0085 USDC a call.

skills.name: Defillama protocols
skills.description: List of every DeFi protocol DefiLlama tracks, with current and historical TVL across chains. 0.006 USDC a call.

skills.name: Exa search
skills.description: Neural and keyword web search. Optional category filter: company, research paper, news, pdf, github, personal site, linkedin profile, financial report. 0.011 USDC a call.

skills.name: Rpc base
skills.description: Multi-chain JSON-RPC from BlockRun across 40 chains (Ethereum, Base, Solana, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, Bitcoin, Sui, and more). One endpoint, every chain, pay-per-call in USDC, no A

skills.name: Exa search
skills.description: Exa Search - Neural search across the web 0.01 USDC a call.

skills.name: Firecrawl search
skills.description: Firecrawl Search - Search the web 0.0252 USDC a call.

skills.name: Fullenrich people search
skills.description: FullEnrich People Search — filter by company domain/name/LinkedIn URL, seniority, title, location, skills, and 20+ FullEnrich filters. Default lean roster: companies map + company_id refs; include_emp

skills.name: Pdl people enrich
skills.description: PDL Person Enrich — career history, emails, phone. Requires one of: `email`, `profile` (LinkedIn URL), or `first_name` + `last_name` + (`company_name` OR `company_domain`). 0.28 USDC a call.
